items.title: Prove local Jarvis startup
items.goal: Make http://127.0.0.1:3000/jarvis reachable from the Commander machine.

items.title: Preserve Builder Core in GitHub
items.goal: Complete local Builder Core chain and prove the files are committed to main.

items.title: Expose Commander real-build lock in runtime
items.goal: Add runtime constants/API so Jarvis can display the active real-build lock and not drift.

items.title: Rebuild Jarvis visual shell
items.goal: Turn the locked visual identity into the real operating surface, not a background with generic cards.

items.title: Improve voice and response quality
items.goal: Jarvis must greet, listen, speak, and answer with Commander-grade language and structure.

items.title: Wire evidence and command state visibly
items.goal: Jarvis must show what it did, what proof exists, and what is blocked.

items.title: Build and smoke proof
items.goal: Run build and smoke tests after implementation changes.
